_comment: Curated human-readable labels for the 256 atlas-v3 L1 scaffold regions.
Each name was written against that region's most representative reservoir
records (the members nearest its centroid), its contrastive terms scored
against document frequency across all 256 regions, and its axis, language
and source mix over a 500,000-record uniform reservoir of the build corpus.
Names are chosen with respect to each other: no two regions share a name.
Subject names only. A language is named only when the language itself is
the subject of the region (language learning, a literary tradition); a
region is never named after the language its records happen to be in.
Geography is named only when the region itself is geographically specific.
Declarative curation: builds and promotion re-apply these names, and the
builder applies this file only when corpus_hash matches the build.
